name: Stock Market 4
description: A research-driven portfolio-management simulation: a bot manages a portfolio of securities across historical-replay or synthetic-scenario markets, optionally informed by an opaque external research snapshot the game merely delivers without interpreting. Portfolio/margin/short-selling/financing/corporate-action mechanics carry forward stock-market-3's proven accounting; execution is deliberately simplified (no order book) to keep the focus on portfolio-management decisions rather than exchange microstructure.
